assertions.A1_delayed_interaction_dropped_over_repl: old interaction snapshot must NOT overwrite replacement turn 8 with old turn 3; adapter/generation/gameState stay on the replacement session
assertions.A2_dropped_after_clear_without_adapter_r: delayed interaction must not call getSnapshot or commit after clear, session identity unchanged
assertions.A3_dropped_if_replacement_during_snapsho: stale getSnapshot result must not overwrite replacement turn 9 with old turn 4
assertions.A4_stale_rejection_suppressed: rejection from replaced session must not surface a notification or change session identity
assertions.C1_uninterrupted_interaction_commits: control: an uninterrupted interaction reply commits normally
assertions.C2_current_session_rejection_reported: control: a rejection in the current session still reports and rethrows

contract.setup: Mock engine adapter; dispatchInteraction with a submit that settles only after a session boundary; then clearPromptOverlayState() + install replacement adapter/generation/snapshot; then release the old submit.

limitations: Client-subsystem reproduction (vitest with mock engine adapter); no engine WS game state involved
Test file is the PR head version applied to the base checkout (purely additive vs base version)
result: On the pre-fix base e17f6fd30211 (PR #9551 base), the 4 new session-ownership tests FAIL: a delayed old interaction called the old adapter getSnapshot after a replacement session was installed and committed old turn 3 over replacement turn 8; the stale rejection surfaced instead of being suppressed. Both controls pass on both builds. All 8 pass on the PR fix head 0737a0d2eda4b.
scope: Client dispatch session-ownership portion of #9319: dispatchInteraction() must not commit a delayed old interaction reply over a replacement session
